We got three templates. Need the one that when applied to the molecule reproduces the reaction described. The precursors list earlier are three SMILES; they likely correspond to the product of the template (target) being reduced to those precursors? Actually the template applied to target gave those precursors. So we need to find which template among these three yields those precursors when applied to target. The result list includes mapped_rxn and template_hash etc. We need template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash). The returned entries have reaction_id but not template_id. Probably template_id is reaction_id? Or maybe template_id is the integer ID of the template (maybe reaction_id). The prompt says "template_id (the one used to search the database not the hash) as an integer". So likely use reaction_id.

We need to pick the correct template. Which one matches DIBAL-H reduction? Look at mapped_rxn strings: first one is huge with many atoms, includes DIBAL-H components? It shows "[H-].CC(C)C[Al+]CC(C)C.ClCCl" which is DIBAL-H (diisobutylaluminum hydride) plus chloride? That seems like the DIBAL-H reagent. So the first template (reaction_id 422121) includes DIBAL-H reagents. That matches DIBAL-H reduction. So we should return its mapped_rxn and template_id = 422121.

Thus final answer JSON.
